description: U.S. National Science Foundation Natural Hazards Engineering Research Infrastructure (NHERI) Decadal Visioning Study 2026-2035 is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Norah Schneider, Nexight Group. The U.S. National Science Foundation Natural Hazards Engineering Research Infrastructure (NHERI) Decadal Visioning Study 2026-2035 provides the natural hazards research community with strategic guidance for improving the sustainability of civil infrastructure and resilience to natural hazard events beyond 2025. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-afza-m544. Keywords: Natural Hazards Engineering Research Infrastructure, NHERI, Science Plan, Multi-Hazards, Resilience, Sustainability. Published 2024-04-25. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0 (labelled "Creative Commons Attribution" on the DesignSafe project). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
